test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters which, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

D Q _ R _ D _ M R _ D _ M _ T

options.text: M Q T T Q R
M T Q R Q T
M T Q T R Q
M T Q T Q R

solution:
Given sequence: D Q _ R _ D _ M R _ D _ M _ T

 
• M Q T T Q R → D Q **M** R **Q** - D **T** M R **T -** D **Q** M **R** T
 
• M T Q R Q T → D Q **M** R **T** - D **Q** M R **R** - D **Q** M **T** T
 
• M T Q T R Q → D Q **M** R **T** - D **Q** M R **T -** D **R** M **Q** T
 
• M T Q T Q R → D Q **M** R **T** - D **Q** M R **T -** D **Q** M **R** T

 
• In option 4, DQMRT is repeated.

Hence, '**M T Q T Q R**' is the correct answer.
